title: Choose PolAI's visual world
question: Keep the condition-report direction, choose the proofing-sheet alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Condition Report
options.thesis: The source text stays the artifact; numbered observations document only what needs attention.
options.viewport: A quiet masthead sits above one continuous workspace: a dominant reading field on the left and a precise findings rail on the right.
options.risk: Can feel bureaucratic if the annotations become dense or the spacing loses warmth.

raised.raise: Highlight state follows one strict accent law instead of decorative color variation.
Findings form one numbered sequence with an unmistakable active position.
Neutral rewrites keep a clear before-and-after relationship.
Every note and exact source span share one linked interaction state.
The empty state uses deliberate quiet instead of placeholder illustration.
Scale establishes source, summary, and finding hierarchy before chrome does.

options.label: Margin Proof
options.lineage: contemporary copy desks and blue-pencil proofing
options.thesis: A modern proofing sheet keeps evidence in the margin while the writing remains uninterrupted.
options.viewport: A large typeset document owns the screen, with a narrow margin column for the summary, score, and linked findings.
options.risk: It is the most familiar and effective option, but can resemble a generic document editor if under-authored.

options.label: Evidence Grid
options.thesis: Each flagged phrase becomes a strict cell in a luminous evidence field.
options.viewport: The text sits inside an integer grid with findings mapped to exact cells.
options.case: The exact grid is legible, but the arcade language misidentifies a serious writing task.
options.kept: One accent law for every active highlight.
options.risk: Turns analysis into a game and conflicts with the requested elegance.

options.label: Analysis Sequence
options.thesis: Findings become a sequenced row that advances through the source one passage at a time.
options.viewport: A compact control strip sits above the editor and marks each finding as a step.
options.case: The sequence clarifies progression, but the instrument metaphor adds controls the task does not need.
options.kept: One numbered sequence with a clear active position.
options.risk: Makes a quiet editor feel technical and busy.

options.label: Revision Folds
options.thesis: Each neutral rewrite unfolds from the original sentence in a deliberate reversible step.
options.viewport: The editor stays central while each finding opens into a before-and-after fold.
options.case: The transformation model is truthful, but the craft metaphor competes with reading speed.
options.kept: A clear before-and-after relationship for rewrites.
options.risk: Feels thematic rather than like a neutral productivity tool.

options.label: Linked Evidence
options.thesis: Source spans and explanations form a single linked network of evidence.
options.viewport: Leader lines connect marked phrases directly to a narrow force-diagram rail.
options.case: The linkage is product-specific, but a spatial network weakens long-form reading clarity.
options.kept: One shared active state between a note and its exact source span.
options.risk: Adds visual mechanics where simple proximity is stronger.

options.label: Quiet Archive
options.thesis: The current document floats forward while prior and future states recede into quiet depth.
options.viewport: A single luminous document occupies a dark field with findings orbiting at the edge.
options.case: The focus is strong, but atmospheric depth reduces editing precision and daylight usability.
options.kept: An empty state that trusts deliberate quiet.
options.risk: Dark cinematic atmosphere contradicts the simple writing-tool brief.

options.label: Typographic Billing
options.thesis: Source, summary, and findings communicate priority through type scale alone.
options.viewport: A single typographic field gives the source most of the width and steps findings down by importance.
options.case: Hierarchy is immediate, but poster billing does not support precise editing controls.
options.kept: Scale carries hierarchy before containers or color.
options.risk: Long prose becomes performative and less comfortable to edit.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished AI-analysis dashboard with familiar cards, a score, and a large action button.
canonCard.viewport: A centered header sits above two rounded cards: editor left, score and findings right.
canonCard.risk: Easy to understand, but visually interchangeable with many AI tools.
